newsitem.title: USA: Protocol sees lower Pryon revs, charge.
newsitem.headline: Protocol sees lower Pryon revs, charge.

text.p: Protocol Systems Inc said on Monday that it expects third quarter revenues from Pryon Corp, which it acquired in February, to be about $1 million less than expected.

Protocol also said in a statement that Pryon's President Daniel Carsten has resigned. Edward Kolasinski, Pryon chief financial officer, will become interim president while a permanent replacement is sought.
Protocol also said it will incur this quarter about $2.1 million in Pryon merger-related expenses, $300,000 more than expected.
In addition, Protocol will take a one-time charge of $275,000 in connection with the settlement of litigation regarding the termination of Protocol's former Canadian distributor in 1991.
Protocol plans to report its third quarter 1996 results on October 24.
Protocol designs, manufactures and markets patient monitoring instruments and related items.
Shares of Protocol closed 1 lower at 14 on Nasdaq.
